FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'Madame' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Sir, Mr
   B. yes
   C. Mrs, Madam
   D. good evening

2. What does 'la fille' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the boy
   B. the girl
   C. the grandfather
   D. the baby

3. What does 'Voici' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the boy
   B. Here is
   C. the father
   D. the sister

4. How do you say 'The rug is in front of the sofa.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   B. Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.
   C. Le tapis est devant le canapé.
   D. C'est une table.

5. What does 'sur' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. in
   B. between
   C. on
   D. under

6. How do you say 'The bag is in the bedroom.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Voici ma maison.
   B. Le sac est dans la chambre.
   C. Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.
   D. Mets le livre dans la chambre.

7. What does 'l'école' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the church
   B. the school
   C. the week
   D. the day

8. Fill in: vendredi, ______, dimanche. (1 mark)
   A. samedi
   B. jeudi
   C. mardi
   D. lundi

9. What does 'dimanche' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Sunday
   B. Tuesday
   C. Saturday
   D. Thursday

10. What does 'un mois' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a month
   B. a birthday
   C. a party
   D. a candle

11. How do you say 'My birthday is on 30 June.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.
   B. Bon anniversaire !
   C. Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin.
   D. J'ai dix ans.

12. What number is 'sept' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 25
   C. 8
   D. 7

13. How do you say 'I drink a juice.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est un gâteau.
   B. C'est bon pour la santé.
   C. Je bois un jus.
   D. Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.

14. Fill in: C'est ______ gâteau. (1 mark)
   A. des
   B. un
   C. la
   D. une

15. What does 'la banane' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. rice
   B. the cake
   C. the banana
   D. vegetables

16. What does 'le doigt' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the tooth
   B. the eyes
   C. the finger
   D. the head

17. Fill in: J'ai ______ bouche. (1) (1 mark)
   A. deux
   B. une
   C. le
   D. un

18. What does 'la jambe' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the eyes
   B. the stomach
   C. the hand
   D. the leg

19. What does 'Il gèle.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is hot.
   B. It is freezing.
   C. It is windy.
   D. It is cloudy.

20. What does 'le vent' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the sun
   B. the weather
   C. the wind
   D. the cloud

21. What does 'Il y a des nuages.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is nice.
   B. It is raining.
   C. It is freezing.
   D. It is cloudy.

22. How do you say 'The rug is under the table.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. La télé est sur la table.
   B. Elle est sous la chaise.
   C. Le frigo est dans la cuisine.
   D. Le tapis est sous la table.

23. What does 'Ça va bien, merci.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. And you?
   B. Yes, I am fine.
   C. Goodbye, Sir.
   D. I am well, thank you.

24. Which little word goes with 'grand-mère' (the grandmother)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. les

25. Which little word goes with 'frigo' (the fridge)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. l'
   C. la
   D. les

26. Which little word goes with 'maison' (the house)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. les
   D. la

27. Read: Voici ma maison. Dans la cuisine, il y a une table et deux chaises. Le frigo est près de la porte. Mon lit est sous la fenêtre. Question: How many chairs are in the kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. three
   B. one
   C. four
   D. two

28. Which little word goes with 'carotte' (the carrot)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. les

29. What does 'Tournez à droite.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. You are welcome!
   B. The TV is on the table.
   C. Turn right.
   D. It is on the table.

30. What does 'Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Go straight ahead.
   B. Excuse me, where is the school?
   C. Turn right.
   D. Where is the key?

31. Fill in: ______ grand-mère s'appelle Grace. (1 mark)
   A. Un
   B. Ma
   C. Mon
   D. Le

32. How do you say 'the shower' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la table
   B. la douche
   C. le sac
   D. la télé

33. How do you say 'in' in French? (1 mark)
   A. entre
   B. dans
   C. devant
   D. sous

34. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'behind'? (1 mark)
   A. derrière
   B. derriere
   C. derriére
   D. derière

35. How do you say 'the week' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le jour
   B. la semaine
   C. l'école
   D. l'église

36. How do you say 'a present' in French? (1 mark)
   A. un ballon
   B. un cadeau
   C. un gâteau
   D. un anniversaire

37. How do you write the number 6 in French? (1 mark)
   A. dix-sept
   B. quatre
   C. quinze
   D. six

38. How do you write the number 9 in French? (1 mark)
   A. douze
   B. quinze
   C. neuf
   D. six

39. How do you say 'the tomato' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la tomate
   B. les frites
   C. le pain
   D. la santé

40. How do you say 'You are welcome' in French? (1 mark)
   A. De rien
   B. Excusez-moi
   C. Tournez
   D. Allez

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into English: 'Elle a les cheveux longs.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into English: 'J'aime le lait.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

44. Translate into French: 'It is under the chair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Read the poem line: Lundi, mardi, mercredi. Write the three days that follow in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'Demain, c'est jeudi.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'The rug is in front of the sofa.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'When is your birthday?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

49. Translate into English: 'Je n'aime pas le poisson.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

50. Translate into English: 'Aujourd'hui, c'est lundi.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

51. Translate into French: 'At midday, I eat rice and beans.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

52. Translate into French: 'I eat a mango.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Translate into English: 'Le ballon est derrière la porte.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

54. Translate into English: 'C'est le premier janvier.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

55. Translate into English: 'C'est ma mère.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

56. Translate into French: 'On Friday, I dance.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into English: 'Quel temps fait-il ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

58. Translate into French: 'My mother is called Grace.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

59. Explain why it is important to store things safely at home. Give two examples. (4 marks) (4 marks)

60. Draw and label a simple bedroom in words: write the French labels for the bed, the door, the window and the chair. (4 marks) (4 marks)

FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7 · MARKING SCHEME

SECTION A
----
1. C — Mrs, Madam
   Madame means Mrs, Madam.

2. B — the girl
   la fille means the girl.

3. B — Here is
   Voici means Here is.

4. C — Le tapis est devant le canapé.
   The rug is in front of the sofa. in French is Le tapis est devant le canapé.

5. C — on
   sur means on.

6. B — Le sac est dans la chambre.
   The bag is in the bedroom. in French is Le sac est dans la chambre.

7. B — the school
   l'école means the school.

8. A — samedi
   Saturday comes after Friday.

9. A — Sunday
   dimanche means Sunday.

10. A — a month
   un mois means a month.

11. C — Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin.
   My birthday is on 30 June. in French is Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin.

12. D — 7
   sept means 7.

13. C — Je bois un jus.
   I drink a juice. in French is Je bois un jus.

14. B — un
   Gâteau is masculine.

15. C — the banana
   la banane means the banana.

16. C — the finger
   le doigt means the finger.

17. B — une
   Bouche is feminine, so une bouche.

18. D — the leg
   la jambe means the leg.

19. B — It is freezing.
   Il gèle. means It is freezing..

20. C — the wind
   le vent means the wind.

21. D — It is cloudy.
   Il y a des nuages. means It is cloudy..

22. D — Le tapis est sous la table.
   The rug is under the table. in French is Le tapis est sous la table.

23. D — I am well, thank you.
   Ça va bien, merci. means I am well, thank you.

24. B — la

25. A — le
   frigo is masculine, so we say le frigo.

26. D — la
   maison is feminine, so we say la maison.

   Deux chaises means two chairs.

28. A — la

29. C — Turn right.

30. B — Excuse me, where is the school?

32. B — la douche

33. B — dans

34. A — derrière
   The correct spelling is derrière, with its accents.

35. B — la semaine
   the week in French is la semaine.

36. B — un cadeau
   a present in French is un cadeau.

37. D — six
   6 in French is six.

38. C — neuf
   9 in French is neuf.

39. A — la tomate
   the tomato in French is la tomate.

40. A — De rien
   You are welcome in French is De rien.
